name: Meta-Rambling Loop
effect: The altered model loses track of what it is being asked. It slips into self-referential talk about 'the question', 'the prompt' and 'I'm asking you to...', invents missing context such as an unseen image, a cut-off sentence or the year, and
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Near miss: judged alone, it failed only the strict specificity check.
